subject: Post-call: Board readiness, procurement asks & pilot path for Pioneer Health
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@pioneerhealth.com>, Sarah Liu <s.liu@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap — Board readiness, procurement asks & pilot path for Pioneer Health

Tom / Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap so we have a single source of truth for your exec and procurement teams. I wrote this with the board/CTO audience in mind.

TL;DR: Pioneer Health is evaluating a 60–90 day pilot to validate realtime chart summarization and redaction at scale. Primary blockers are SOC2 evidence, procurement SOW terms, and data residency controls. Pioneer execs want a clean path to a low-risk pilot with clear success metrics and an explicit procurement timeline.

Key pain points (from today):
- Clinical documentation backlog: 9,000 notes / month with average 7 min manual summary time per note.
- PHI redaction consistency: current process misses edge-case identifiers in ~4% of records.
- Latency & integration: provider UX needs <250ms token latency on 95th pct for sentence-level suggestions.

Business goals & success metrics:
- Pilot scope: 5 clinics, ~2,000 notes / week, end-to-end workflow integration with Epic API.
- Success metric 1: reduce average summary time per note from 7 min -> <2.5 min.
- Success metric 2: decrease PHI redaction misses to <0.5% on evaluated sample sets.
- Stakeholder: Jane Park (VP Product + Board sponsor) will sign off on pilot success.

Procurement path & timeline (proposed):
1) Week 0–1: Redwood provides SOC2 summary + SOW draft and pilot pricing. (ACTION: Redwood)
2) Week 1–2: Pioneer legal/proc review SOW; Redwood accepts redlines for pilot (target: <7 business days). (ACTION: Pioneer + Redwood legal)
3) Week 2–4: Set up infra (VPC peering + test dataset), solutions eng run smoke tests. (ACTION: Redwood solutions eng + Pioneer infra)
4) Week 4–12: Pilot execution, weekly checkpoints with Jane and ops; mid-pilot evaluation at week 6.

Risks & escalation items we flagged:
- Data residency & retention policy — Pioneer requires proof of EU-only processing for some clinics (we discussed a data residency outline).
- SLA & uptime expectations during pilot — baseline SLOs need to be documented for support handoffs.
- Legal redlines around data usage & IP — procurement asked for one-way data use for model improvement (we recommended opt-out for pilot).

Immediate asks from Pioneer:
- SOC2 evidence (summary + auditor contact) — Procurement wants this in-hand before legal reviews SOW.
- Standard pilot SOW with an explicit 60-day timeline and termination clause.
- Pilot pricing (including any one-time infra/setup) and proposed credit/discount for the pilot.

What Redwood will deliver this week: 
- Attached: Redwood pilot outline (PDF), SOW draft (DOCX), SOC2 summary (PDF).
- Contact for solutions eng kickoff: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) — happy to schedule a 30m tech kickoff as early as next Wed.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- Pioneer: confirm procurement contact and expected review window for SOW.
- Pioneer: confirm target clinics (5) + data owner for Epic integration.
- Redwood: propose pilot pricing & a one-time $X credit for the pilot (we'll confirm authorization).

If this looks right I'll loop in Legal to accept limited redlines and loop Solutions Eng to schedule the kickoff.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
attachments: Redwood-pilot-outline-Pioneer-v1.pdf, SOW-draft-Pioneer-PNR-4321.docx, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <s.liu@pioneerhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — Board readiness, procurement asks & pilot path for Pioneer Health

Priya — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. A couple quick clarifications from procurement / product: 

1) Timeline: Our procurement lead (procurement@pioneerhealth.com) wants to complete legal review in the next 10 business days if we can provide SOC2 evidence and a tightened SOW. Is your SOW draft the "pilot-only" version with a unilateral termination for Pioneer?

2) SOC2: Can you include the auditor contact and most recent test window dates (we need the 2025–2026 scope). Also, please include a short note on how you handle ePHI during model fine-tuning (if any).

3) Pricing: high-level ask from finance — what is the list price for a 60-day pilot for the 5-clinic scope, and what credit can Redwood authorize pre-legal? We need a simple line item (setup, monthly pilot, infra).

Jane Park (cc'ed) will review the pilot charter next Tue and will flag any major blockers.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Harris | Dir, Digital Transformation | Pioneer Health

From: Sarah Liu <s.liu@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — Board readiness, procurement asks & pilot path for Pioneer Health

All — I read this and it aligns with what Jane asked for. Two things from product: 

- Please include expected support cadence (weekly checkpoints + on-call escalation) in the SOW.
- Can you send a one-page data residency outline for the EU clinics (we flagged a subset that must remain in-region)?

If we get SOC2 evidence and the one-pager on residency by Friday, we'll aim to have legal review completed the following week. Also: please put an estimated rollout cost if the pilot is successful and we roll to 20 clinics — Jane will want a ballpark.

Appreciate it — Sarah
Sarah Liu | Head of Product, Clinical Apps | Pioneer Health

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — Board readiness, procurement asks & pilot path for Pioneer Health

Priya / Marcus — quick internal note: I reviewed the call notes and approve offering a 60-day pilot with the following guardrails: 

- Pilot credit: authorize up to 50% off list for pilot compute + one-time $5k setup credit (we'll flex if there are integration complexities).
- Legal: Redwood legal to accept limited, pilot-only redlines (no IP transfer; one-way data use with opt-out; liability cap aligned with pilot fees). I'll loop in Legal (cc'ed) and Solutions Eng to prepare the residency outline.
- Risk mitigation: provide a short runbook for incident escalation and an SLO appendix for the pilot.

Marcus — please prepare a 30m solutions kickoff and include an initial smoke-test checklist (VPC peering, sample payloads, latency targets). Priya — please confirm Pioneer procurement contact and request the SOC2 auditor contact.

I'll authorize the pilot credit pending Legal confirmation on the proposed redlines.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao | Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
